project_type: Multi-module Maven monorepo (Java 17 / Spring Boot services) + a React/TypeScript frontend (frontend-app) + CloudFormation YAML templates under cloudformation/. Backend module of interest: xamops-service.
build_system: Maven reactor with root pom.xml (modules: service-registry, permissions-common, xamops-service, billops, media-ops-service, api-gateway). NO maven wrapper in repo; use system `mvn` (3.9.12 verified on PATH). Frontend: npm + Vite + Vitest in frontend-app.
test_framework: Backend: JUnit 5 + Mockito + AssertJ + Spring ReflectionTestUtils (see xamops-service/src/test/java/com/xammer/cloud/service/AwsAccountServiceDeleteAccountTest.java for the construction pattern: positional constructor + ReflectionTestUtils.setField for @Value fields + mocked repositories). Frontend: Vitest (`vitest run`).
build_command: mvn -q -pl xamops-service -am test-compile   (fast compile gate, run from the worktree root)
test_command: Backend: `mvn -q -pl xamops-service -am test` from worktree root. Frontend: `npm run test` (vitest run) and `npm run build` (typecheck) in frontend-app.
verification_instructions: 1) Part A (CFN): per-file grep assertions are authoritative. After edits, for each of the eight templates: grep -c must be 0 for AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource, XamOpsCurReport, XamOpsCurExport, XamOpsCurManager, EnableCurReport, EnableCurExport, DeployCurReport, DeployCurExport, CreatesOwnCurBucket, IsCurReportRegion, Unconditional, XamOpsCurReadAccess; and grep -c must be 1 for each of XamOpsCurBucketRead, XamOpsCurAthenaQuery, XamOpsCurGlueCatalog, XamOpsCurAthenaResultsWrite, and HasCurBucket:/AutoCurBucket:/CurS3Bucket present. 2) Backend: run the xamops-service test suite. 3) Frontend: npm run build (typecheck) + npm run test. PyYAML cannot parse CFN short-form tags (!Ref etc.) so do NOT rely on yaml.safe_load for template validity; use the grep assertions (and `aws cloudformation validate-template` only if AWS creds exist).
snapshot_or_generated_files: None. CloudFormation templates are uploaded to S3 out of band; there is no in-repo build step that regenerates them. The preprod templates referenced by application-preprod.properties (xamops-readonly-rolepreprod.yml, xamops-readwrite-role-preprod.yml) DO NOT EXIST in the repo and are out of code scope.
environment_constraints: No maven wrapper; use system mvn. PyYAML does not understand CFN intrinsic short tags. AWS credentials may be absent, so do not depend on aws cloudformation validate-template. Do NOT create any CUR 2.0 / AWS::BCMDataExports resources anywhere (out of scope).
contribution_requirements: CONTRIBUTING.md and README.md exist at repo root (no AGENTS.md, no .kiro/steering). Follow existing code style/conventions in each module. Flyway migrations live in xamops-service/src/main/resources/db/migration with name pattern V<yyyymmdd>_<seq>__<desc>.sql; highest existing slot is V20261024_38, so V20261024_39 is the free next slot. Commit locally on branch cur-two-stack; never push.
key_patterns: Backend @Value config injection with optional defaults via `${prop:}`; CloudAccount JPA entity uses @Column(name=...) fields with explicit getters/setters; service methods return Map<String,Object>; controller copies selected keys into a response Map. Flyway migrations use `ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS`, nullable, no backfill (see V20260911_1__account_stack_identity.sql). Frontend: hooks expose state+actions via a typed *Return interface; forms receive props from the page; apiFetch wraps fetch. The CUR-stack gating constant is `createReport = "OWN_CUR".equals(awsBillingSource)`.
directory_structure: cloudformation/ = all CFN templates (eight connection role templates + xamops-cur-report.yml CUR stack). xamops-service/src/main/java/com/xammer/cloud/{service,domain,controller} = backend logic; .../resources/db/migration = Flyway SQL; .../resources/application-*.properties = per-profile config (cur url in local/uat/prod/preprod, NOT in base). frontend-app/src/{types,hooks,components/AddAccount,components/AccountManager,pages} = React onboarding + account-manager UI.

findings_from_exploration.AwsBillingSource_has_no_ownsCur: The enum has usesCustomerOwnedCur() (OWN_CUR+EXISTING_CUR), usesXamopsOwnedCur(), usesCur() but NO ownsCur(). Per task Resolution #1 fallback, use `== AwsBillingSource.OWN_CUR` for the CUR applicable flag, matching the existing createReport gating and Resolution #5.
findings_from_exploration.resolveAwsBillingSource: CloudAccount.resolveAwsBillingSource() exists, returns AwsBillingSource, never null (falls back to COST_EXPLORER_ONLY).
findings_from_exploration.cur_url_property: cloudformation.template.s3.cur.url present in application-local/-uat/-prod/-preprod, absent from base application.properties -> use @Value("${cloudformation.template.s3.cur.url:}").
findings_from_exploration.grep_matrix_confirmed: All eight connection templates contain XamOpsCurManager and the four conditional CUR Sids once each; xamops-readonly-role-local.yml is CUR-1.0-only (0 XamOpsCurExport/DeployCurExport/CreatesOwnCurBucket/Unconditional/XamOpsCurReadAccess). IsCurReportRegion = 0 everywhere.
findings_from_exploration.update_guide_consumer: frontend-app/src/components/AccountManager/CloudAccountsTable.tsx (StackUpdateGuide iface line ~12; setUpdateGuide ~188; renders twoPassWarning/consoleUrl/likelyStackName/templateUrl/parameters). StackUpdateModal.tsx is the change-set path and does NOT consume the guide.
findings_from_exploration.test_pattern: AwsAccountServiceDeleteAccountTest builds the service via its positional constructor + ReflectionTestUtils.setField for @Value fields + mocked repositories.
